description: Creates a NEW website for an event the person organizes, as a DRAFT nobody else sees. `startFrom`: `event` (default, a page per part with live agenda, speakers, booths, venue and FAQ), `blank`, or `{url}`, a public page whose STRUCTURE only is rebuilt with the event's live data; no words, images, logos or fonts are copied. FIRST CALL WITHOUT `confirm` returns a PREVIEW with a `changeId` and creates nothing; only when the organizer says yes, call again with `confirm: true` and that `changeId`. Nothing is live until site_publish. At most 20 sites an event. Only the organizer can create one; refusals are read out as given. It needs a personal connector token.

changeId.description: The preview id; required with confirm.

confirm.description: Absent previews only; true creates the previewed site.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or name as the organizer spells it.

url.description: The address of one public web page.

name: site_create
title: Create an event website (organizers only)
